item.title: Research Finds Common Baby Formula Ingredient May Be Causing Liver Disease in Infants
item.description: A study conducted using pigs seems to have found a connection between a common ingredient used in baby formula and fatty liver disease.

item.title: Walmart Has Issued a Recall of Popular Cottage Cheese Product
item.description: Walmart has issued a product recall after concerns were raised about the pasteurization process of its Great Value brand cottage cheese.

item.title: Want To Grow Your Family? This Is the Time of Year When Men Are Most Fertile
item.description: Scientists say they have been able to uncover the time of year that men are at their most fertile, and produce their highest quality sperm.

item.title: Third-Party Testing Reveals Possible Salmonella Contamination in Dog Treats, Prompting Recall
item.description: A Florida-based dog treat company recalled a single lot of dog treats after third-party testing uncovered possible Salmonella contamination.

item.title: Yellowstone’s Most Acidic Geyser Erupts After Years of Inactivity
item.description: Yellowstone has documented an eruption from its Echinus Geyser, which slowly ceased erupting in the decades leading up to it's last 20217 show.

item.title: Are Shipping Container Homes Actually Good For The Environment?
item.description: Are shipping container homes actually good for the environment? The reality is more complex than it appears on the surface.

item.title: The Role of Data Science in ESG & Sustainability Reporting
item.description: This is where data science is useful. It enables companies to stay on top of what is actually happening, identify issues earlier and avoid actions that could destroy their reputation.

item.title: Statement Released by U.S. Government Seems To Hint at Military Action in Ecuador
item.description: Did the U.S. military bomb Ecuador? A statement released by the government suggests strikes were carried out against suspected drug traffickers.

item.title: Frito-Lay Announces a Recall of Its Popular Flavored Chips Over Potential Allergens
item.description: Frito-Lay has issued a recall of some of the Miss Vickie's Spicy Dill Pickle Potato Chips due to the potential of an undeclared allergen.

item.title: 32 Countries Named in Travel Advisory Due to a Spike in Polio Cases
item.description: The CDC has named 32 countries in a travel advisory, warning U.S. residents about an increase in polio cases and suggesting they avoid the region.
